text:
Maya Nguyen: Quick plan check - launch social playbook: X thread + LinkedIn longform + micro-influencer seeding. Need final copy + assets and routing for demo signups. Who owns what? :rocket:
Rina Gomez: I'll produce 3 copy variants: A) benchmark-led, B) customer-story, C) feature-first. Short and long forms for both platforms. Dropping in #marketing-docs by 2pm.
Omar Vasquez: I'll assemble a 20s highlight + 7s teaser clips. Will export 9:16 and 1:1. Please mark the exact hook timestamps.
Hannah Lee: Scheduling: Target launch Wed 09:30 PT for X thread, 10:30 PT LinkedIn. Buffer window OK? Also want follow-up reply cadence: reply 1 = signup CTA at +30m, reply 2 = highlight clip at +90m, poll at +3h. Thoughts?
Tony Wu: I'll run influencer outreach for 6 dev-focused creators. Request: short brief + suggested caption. We should include disclose line: "Sponsored" or "Partner" if paid.
LegalBot: Benchmarks OK if phrased per clearance doc. Suggested phrasing: "observed ~2x median latency improvement in our benchmark suite." Must include source link in the longform. Influencer disclosures required for paid/promoted posts.
Maya Nguyen: Good. Rina: keep benchmark phrasing to LegalBot's wording. Tony: share the outreach list so LegalBot can pre-approve disclosure language.
Rina Gomez: Noted. Variant A will have the legal-approved benchmark sentence as-is. Variant B will avoid numeric claims and use attendee quote.
SDRBot: Routing rules reminder: if company_size>250 OR job_title contains "VP"/"Head"/"Director" => tag=hot and route to AE_inbound. Others => tag=nurture. Slack alerts to #inbound-leads with priority flag.
Sam Reed: Webhook payload will include: `{"email":"{{email}}","company":"{{company}}","company_size":"{{company_size}}","utm_campaign":"launch_q2","variant":"A|B|C"}`. Confirming we need variant field for funnel analysis.
Hannah Lee: UTM templates: `utm_source=(x|linkedin)&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=launch_q2_variantA`. I'll parameterize in Buffer.
Tony Wu: Micro-influencer plan: 3 paid (boost) + 3 organic. For paid posts we will add `#ad` and a 2-sentence brief. I'll post the ask doc by EOD.
Maya Nguyen: Engagement follow-up: 1) Reply with 1-click signup, 2) 30s demo clip reply, 3) poll to learn top pain point. Keep replies under the same thread for continuity.
Rina Gomez: For copy experiments, can we A/B test the CTA: "Reserve your seat" vs "Watch the on-demand"? We'll tag links differently.
LegalBot: CTA phrasing fine. If we use on-demand, ensure recording is live within 48h. If we promise a resource, it must be available.
Omar Vasquez: Uploading masters to /marketing/launch_q2/creative/ by 5pm with captions (.vtt). Will add short(preview).mp4 for tweet reply.
SDRBot: Also recommend a 1-hour rolling alert for 'hot' signups. Assign an SLA: SDR responds within 60 minutes.
Sam Reed: I'll wire the Zapier flow: Form -> CRM -> Slack. Will append variant and utm fields. ETA tonight.
Maya Nguyen: Ok recap + owners: copy (Rina), clips (Omar), schedule + Buffer (Hannah), influencer outreach (Tony), webhook/CRMSync (Sam), routing + alerts (SDRBot), legal sign-off (LegalBot).
Tony Wu: One more ask: can we get 2 boosted windows? Day 0 morning + Day 1 evening. Budget TBD.
Hannah Lee: Yes. I'll set boost windows and share the calendar invite with timestamps.
Maya Nguyen: Final: drop final copy and assets by EOD. We'll do a 9am final check tomorrow. If anything urgent flag me directly. :thumbsup:
